notes: Loop 3 (was 8.0). Phone first, every screenshot sliced. Fixed: step 4 shows no '11' or '7' until a guess (report-phone.png; data-wi-be-reveal, sections.ts:686-700). On the landing the break-even dot sits on the line with 'Gewinnschwelle 11 pro Tag' whole, and 'vorsichtig' no longer runs into '−385 €'. The facts card is open on the phone. Chips, verdicts and the break-even each have one word ('Gewinnschwelle (auf Englisch: Break-even)' once). The six interview answers all differ. New and good: the wage card (+43 € / −42 € / +1 € bars), 'Wo die Wirklichkeit gelandet ist' with both thresholds and the measured 6, and the /try rehearsal grid with an honest caveat. Still adding load: bars and cards say 'Erwartet' (in all four languages) for the owner's likely guess. The VAT row wears one 'Eine Schätzung' chip, with the 7 %/19 % split folded away. The explorer's red-to-green turn still shows the crossing above the empty predict box. '36,57 € pro Tag zu decken' is one lump. The wage bar says '+1 €' and the text '1,40 €'. /try screen 9 has five fields and no why, and the review screen holds 12 open fields (4,300 px). The self-check is folded.
improvements: Scenario labels on every chart (src/engine/messages.de.ts:11 scn.expected, :408-409; the bars in report.txt:180-186, the card head 'Erwartet · Ihre wahrscheinliche Schätzung' :189-190, the result line and bars report-result.txt:470-486, the landing's step-3 mini chart 'erwartet' landing.txt:133). Rename the middle bar 'Wahrscheinlich' (EN 'Likely', ES 'Probable', PL 'Prawdopodobny') so the chart word matches the input row ('Ihre wahrscheinliche Schätzung'). Use one trio in the step-3 intro and on the landing ('vorsichtig / wahrscheinlich / optimistisch' instead of 'schwacher Start … starker Start' and 'langsamer Start … starker Verlauf'). Why: the chart is where a learner reads 'Erwartet −118 €' as a forecast. Two names for one bar also cost a second look. It worked when no chart, card or landing visual says Erwartet/Expected/Esperado/Oczekiwany.

Step 4 explorer (src/report/charts.ts sensChart, src/report/sections.ts:686-720). (a) Until the owner guesses or taps 'Einfach zeigen', draw the result line in one neutral colour. Today it turns from red to green exactly at the zero crossing, which on the phone sits just above x=11, one screen below the empty predict box (report-phone.png step 4). (b) In 'Warum sich das geändert hat', split the lump '8 × 5,35 € − 36,57 € pro Tag zu decken' (report.txt:306) into '13,57 € wechselnde Stammgäste + 18,00 € Personal + 5,00 € Werbung'. Draw that 36,57 € as a labelled 'pro Tag zu decken' line, so the slope (5,35 € per guest) visibly works against a fixed bar. Why: the slider teaches only the slope. The least intuitive cost, regulars who switch, is never seen, and the guess should come before the chart answers it. It worked when report-phone.png shows a one-colour line before the reveal and the why box names the three daily costs.

Step 2 VAT row and the facts card (src/report/sections.ts step2 filledGroup and factsCard; src/engine/types.ts:10 Source has no rule chip). Show the row in view as '7 % / 19 % [Öffentliche Regel] × Aufteilung 70/30 [Eine Schätzung] = 10,6 %', not '10,6 % · Eine Schätzung' (report-phone.png step 2, report.txt:140-145). Give each facts-card item a small 'Öffentliche Regel' chip and add it to the 'Was die Etiketten bedeuten' legend. The 30 % drinks share is listed as a rule (report.txt:162) while the folded note calls the split 'geschätzt'. Label it 'Pauschale (Regel)' and the fit to her deal 'angenommen'. Why: colour and chip are how the report teaches source. A public, dated rule is the one kind of number with no chip, so the phone reader sees VAT as a guess first. It worked when report-phone.png shows both chips on the VAT row and the legend lists six labels.

Price demo wage card (report-price-phone.png, report-price.txt:204-216; the bar chart in src/report/sections.ts). Make the 'Bleibt pro Woche' bar say '+1,40 €' like the text, or round both. Add a dashed bar 'mit Arbeitgeberanteilen (Schätzung, etwa 20 %)' so the caveat 'vor Arbeitgeberanteilen' is visible, not only read. Put a small 'kommt mit und ohne neuen Preis' tag on the wage bar. Why: one figure shown two ways makes a learner doubt both. The caveat that can flip the verdict is only in small print. It worked when the bar and the text agree and the employer-share bar sits under the 'Bleibt' bar.

/try screens 9 and 11 (try-phone-09.png, try-phone-11.png). Screen 9 has five inputs and is the only data screen without the 'Warum das wichtig ist' box. Add one ('Jeder Euro hier muss erst von zusätzlichen Gästen hereingeholt werden') or split it into 'Startkosten' and 'laufende Kosten' screens. The review screen shows 12 assumed values open in one panel (4,300 px). Move the range and the switching share onto their own screens with 'Weiß ich nicht', and keep the panel to the rest. Relabel 'Anteil des Preises für Zutaten und Verpackung' as '… bei Ihren normalen Mittagsverkäufen', so it does not look like a repeat of the 3,60 € she just typed. Why: one question per screen is the wizard's own scaffold, and a 12-field wall at the end is where an owner stops reading. It worked when try-phone-11.png is under 2,500 px and screen 9 shows a why.

Step 6 and the after-test page. Show the self-check's first question open, not as a closed 'Regel üben' row under the print button (report-phone.png step 6, sections.ts:801). On #demo-result, make the primary button the next test ('Anpassung testen: 10,90 € eine Woche'), not 'Test gemacht? Ergebnis eintragen' again (report-result-phone.png, bottom). Under 'Wo die Wirklichkeit gelandet ist', add one bar pair that splits the miss: −107 € from 2 fewer guests, +41 € from fewer switchers. Why: the practice and the loop are the active parts of the lesson, and on a phone a folded row is a skipped row. It worked when report-phone.png shows a tappable question without opening anything, and report-result-phone.png ends on a next-test button.
misconceptionsRisked: 'Erwartet' on the bars and cards reads as a forecast (report.txt:182, 189; landing mini chart; result chart 'Erwartet: 8').
VAT 10,6 % carries only a guess chip, so 'VAT is one of my guesses'. The rule chip does not exist (report-phone.png step 2).
'The 20 cents cover the wage rise': the 'Bleibt pro Woche +1 €' bar has no employer-share bar beside it (report-price-phone.png).
'Break-even is wherever the line turns green': this is right, but it shows before the guess, so the predict box tests chart reading, not the idea.
scaffoldingGaps: The explorer line's colour change reveals the crossing above the empty predict box.
The daily cost to cover (36,57 €) is one number, so the switching mechanism has no picture.
/try screen 9 has five fields and no why; the review screen has 12 open fields.
The self-check is folded, and after a result the page ends on 'Ergebnis eintragen' instead of the next test.
The report grew on the phone: 12,926 px, against 11,763 px in loop 2.
languageLoad: On screen the German is about as compact as the English (12,926 px vs 11,939 px at 390 px), with correct formats (9,90 €, 1.500 €, −117,70 €) and one word per chip and verdict. Its leftover load is labels: 'Erwartet' on the charts against 'wahrscheinliche Schätzung' in the rows; 'Was eine Simulation sagen kann' (report.txt:446) while every other heading says 'Probelauf'; and a 16-word break-even label that wraps to four lines in the predict box (report-phone.png). Spanish keeps the chips consistent, but the step status 'HECHO' sits beside 'Hecho por una IA', and 'Clientes más al mediodía' is awkward on every row. Polish reads naturally, but its charts say 'Oczekiwany' and 'fakty' covers both her numbers and the Berlin rules.
